breakdown.description: Formation energy and defect concentration are evaluated at different Fermi levels and different temperatures.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt contained contradictory instructions to evaluate formation energy and defect concentration at different Fermi levels and temperatures. The agent's generated specification repeated these contradictory instructions verbatim, instructing the calculation of formation energy at Fermi level 0.3 eV and defect concentration at Fermi level 1.0 eV and temperature 1000 K. The ground truth resolved this by removing these specific, conflicting values, which the agent failed to do.
